answer: The inlet schedule is applied in quartz and ocean makes public each instalment. A payout is split so that 23% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An adversary hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 902 identities would post 1735 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
